description: This Java class models a customer attribute entity in the sales management system, representing customer-specific attributes with database mapping via JPA annotations.

classes.name: CustomerAttribute
classes.description: Entity class representing an attribute associated with a customer, mapped to the CUSTOMER_ATTRIBUTE database table, with relationships to customer options and values.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the primary key ID of the customer attribute.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the primary key ID of the customer attribute.

methods.name: setCustomerOption
methods.description: Assigns a CustomerOption to this attribute.

methods.name: getCustomerOptionValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with the customer option.

methods.name: setCustomerOptionValue
methods.description: Sets the value for the customer option.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves the Customer associated with this attribute.

methods.name: setCustomer
methods.description: Associates a Customer with this attribute.

methods.name: setTextValue
methods.description: Sets a text value for this customer attribute.

methods.name: getTextValue
methods.description: Retrieves the text value of this customer attribute.
